name: Onboarding for Executives
summary: Immerse yourself in a white glove tour of a new building and ask live questions of Senior Human Resources and IT staff before ever stepping into the office in-person! Teleport or manually move to follow the tour and then meet your leadership team in the metaverse to build lasting connections from Day 1.  Gain familiarization to thrive in your work environment from your VR headset and email yourself key information from this simulation that uses an Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbot!
